Test Scenario: Verify successful login with valid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page. 2. Enter valid email and password. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: User should be redirected to homepage and session is active.

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page. 2. Enter invalid email and valid password. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Error message "Invalid credentials" should be displayed.

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to product details. 2. Click "Add to Cart".
Expected Result: Product is added to cart and cart counter increments.

Test Scenario: Verify max quantity limit for a single product
Test Steps: 1. Add product to cart. 2. Increase quantity to max limit (e.g. 99). 3. Try to add one more.
Expected Result: System should prevent adding more than max limit and show a warning.

Test Scenario: Verify checkout with zero items in cart
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Cart page. 2. Click "Proceed to Checkout".
Expected Result: Checkout button should be disabled or redirect to "Cart Empty" message.

Preconditions: Items in cart; User logged in
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Checkout. 2. Enter valid shipping details. 3. Select Payment method. 4. Click "Place Order".
Expected Result: Order is created successfully order status is "Pending" and order confirmation is shown.

Test Scenario: Verify applying an expired coupon code
Preconditions: Items in cart; Expired coupon code available
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Cart. 2. Enter expired coupon code. 3. Click "Apply".
Expected Result: Error message "Coupon code expired" is displayed; total is not discounted.

Test Scenario: Verify password length limits during registration
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Registration. 2. Enter password with less than 8 characters. 3. Click Register.
Expected Result: Validation error "Password must be at least 8 characters" is displayed.

Test Steps: 1. Send POST request to /api/users with valid JSON. 2. Check response.
Expected Result: Response code is 201 Created and user data is returned.
